ios.desc:
Stintly is the all-in-one AI-powered invoice maker and expense tracker built for freelancers, independent contractors, and small business owners. Create professional invoices, scan receipts with AI, track billable hours, and estimate your 1099 taxes — all 100% offline, no internet required.

SMART AI INVOICING
• Create polished invoices in seconds with AI-suggested line items
• AI auto-detects billable work and prompts you to invoice
• Send invoices via email with one tap
• Track payments, partial payments, and overdue balances
• Recurring invoice detection and automation
• Support for 85+ currencies worldwide

AI-POWERED EXPENSE TRACKING
• Snap a photo — AI reads receipts and auto-fills expenses
• Voice expense entry: just say "$45 at Staples for supplies"
• Natural language input: type expenses in plain English
• Smart categorization with Schedule C tax mapping
• Bank statement import (CSV)
• Recurring expense detection and alerts

TIME TRACKING & BILLING
• One-tap timer for billable hours
• Manual time entry with rounding rules
• Convert tracked time directly to invoices
• Idle time detection — never miss billable work
• Weekly business summary with AI insights

1099 TAX TOOLS
• Real-time tax liability estimator
• Quarterly estimated tax calculator
• Schedule C deduction optimizer
• Mileage tracking with IRS rate
• Tax-deductible expense categorization
• Export to TurboTax, QuickBooks, or Xero

20+ ON-DEVICE AI FEATURES
• AI Business Assistant — ask anything about your finances
• Cash flow forecasting and profit predictions
• Client health scoring and churn prediction
• Smart rate suggestions based on market data
• Invoice dispute helper with evidence gathering
• Expense anomaly detection
• Financial insights and weekly AI briefings
• All AI runs locally on your device — your data never leaves your phone

CLIENT MANAGEMENT
• Organize clients with contact details and job history
• Track revenue per client and profitability
• Follow-up queue for overdue invoices and stale estimates
• Client onboarding wizard with AI checklists

WORKS 100% OFFLINE
• No account required to start
• All data stored locally on your device
• Optional iCloud backup and sync
• No internet needed for any feature
• Your financial data stays private

REPORTS & EXPORTS
• Profit & loss reports
• Revenue analytics and trends
• Expense breakdowns by category and vendor
• PDF report generation and sharing
• CSV export for accountants

FREE TO START
• Generous free tier with core features

quotes.text:
I built Stintly, an all-in-one business management app for freelancers, contractors, and self-employed professionals. It runs entirely offline with all data stored locally on your device.

What it does:
  - Invoicing & estimates with on-site signature capture
  - Expense tracking with receipt scanning and voice input
  - Time tracking with one-tap timers
  - Job/project management with photo documentation
  - Schedule C tax tracking with quarterly estimates
  - Client management with revenue history
  - Reports & analytics with PDF export

What makes it different:

Privacy-first: All data lives on your device. No account required. No tracking, no ads, no data selling. Optional iCloud backup if you want it.

Offline-first: Works 100% without internet — SQLite on device. Most competitors (FreshBooks, Wave, QuickBooks) require a connection.

On-device AI: 20+ AI features (receipt OCR, voice expense entry, cash flow forecasting, tax optimization, client insights) run locally via Llama on Metal GPU. No data leaves your phone.

Tech stack: React Native/Expo, SQLite, NativeWind, on-device LLM via react-native-llama.cpp with Metal acceleration, custom OTA updates via Cloudflare Workers + R2.

Pricing: Free tier (5 clients, 5 invoices, unlimited use) forever. Pro at $12.99/mo, Premium with AI at $19.99/mo.

Currently on iOS (iPhone/iPad/Mac). Would love feedback from other freelancers and indie devs on what's missing or what you'd want from a tool like this.
